problem_type: Derived trace privacy and ownership must survive cold rebuild and project copies
symptom: Review of C70 found that cold rebuild could restore a credential removed by the live view, and copied projects could open another project trace.
direct_cause: Live rendering knew in-memory secrets; cold history did not. The live registry originally keyed globally by sessionId, which survives copying a project.
class_root: A rebuildable view must carry its privacy decisions in its authoritative source and scope transient owners by the source file, not a portable identifier.
affected_population: New C70 traces containing known credentials echoed by a model or tool
Copied local projects retaining the same native pi sessionId
History opened without a configured model
internal_only_reason: The invariant concerns Nomi derived-view privacy and local project ownership. pi remains the unchanged serializer and Session mutation owner; official source research is recorded in docs/plan/2026-09-10-trace-log.md.
invariants: Known-secret redaction positions are durable standard custom entries containing no secret or copied text.
Every derived writer applies those positions before serialization.
A live trace owner is keyed by the absolute native session path.
Derived write failure does not prevent reading or executing the original session.
Only the trusted current main window can request a native metadata-resolved directory; no arbitrary renderer path reaches shell.openPath.
generality_proof: Every live/cold writer converges on writeLaneTrace; durable source positions remove dependence on currently configured credentials. Native source paths distinguish project copies with identical portable ids.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Apply durable redactions and safe value projection before publishing either derived format.
Scope each live owner to the native source path.
Validate sender/lane, resolve current project and revalidate after async rebuild before shell dispatch.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Attaches one recorder and publishes source-backed views after native settlement.
Uses shared writer and registers the exact source path without requiring credentials.
Resolves native metadata and shares the live writer or SDK reader for cold rebuild.

recurrence.reason: Any later cold open or copied project can reproduce the mechanism; not tied to one provider.
same_class_scan: Independently inspected run completion, read-only history and directory rebuild.

prevention.invariant: Both derived formats use source-backed redaction and source-scoped ownership.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsafe trace publication fails; directory IPC returns a bounded error; native session remains usable.
prevention.strategy: Persist privacy locations in pi custom entries and apply centrally before serialization; key live ownership by native file path.

legacy_paths.rationale: C70 is a new derived view; the existing pi JSONL persistence is neither replaced nor migrated.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The bug is Nomi view identity/privacy state, not pi serialization. No dependency change is needed.

migration: Existing native sessions remain unchanged. Recorded redaction positions travel with the source; older sessions without C70 timing retain explicit unknown values.
residual_risks: Unknown credentials in historical native text cannot be identified exhaustively; generic credential patterns still apply. Nomi does not rewrite pre-existing native transcripts.
